title: SoftPlay Total Agentic Mode — Jira / Confluence connections
description: Addresses and modes only. This file must never contain credentials: usernames, passwords and tokens are entered in a masked VS Code prompt and kept in memory for the session. Any key that looks like a credential is rejected when the file is loaded.

connections.description: Every Jira / Confluence deployment the agent may read. Ids must be unique.

id.description: Stable identifier. Credentials are scoped to this id, not merely to the host.

label.description: Shown to the user, e.g. in the 'Connect securely' prompt.

enabled.description: false = placeholder: local-file chat works and any link to it is answered with setup guidance.

baseUrl.description: https origin plus the deployment's context path, no trailing slash needed — e.g. https://jira.example.com or https://tools.example.com/jira. No credentials, query string or fragment. Required when enabled.

deployment.description: 'datacenter' = Jira/Confluence Data Center or Server REST API. Atlassian Cloud and other deployments are not implemented.

authMode.description: 'pat' = personal access token sent as 'Authorization: Bearer' (Jira 8.14+/Confluence 7.9+). 'basic' = username + password, only where your administrator permits it. SSO/MFA-only deployments are not supported.

acceptanceCriteriaFieldIds.description: Jira only: custom-field ids that hold acceptance criteria, e.g. ["customfield_10200"]. No id is assumed.
